modules.name: admin-console
modules.description: Settings/users/flags surface every app grows — one console instead of scattered admin fragments.

modules.name: agent-router
modules.description: Multi-agent apps need 'which agent handles this' as data, not nested ifs sprinkled by build agents.

modules.name: agent-runtime
modules.description: Hosts the app's agents. v0 is a deterministic stub honoring the roster contract; real mode swaps respond() for a Claude Agent SDK session with the same signature.

modules.name: agent-runtime-adk
modules.description: The agent-runtime contract implemented on Google ADK — an LlmAgent driven by an ADK Runner executes every reply; the model behind it is stub/live-cli/live-api like the base runtime.

modules.name: agent-runtime-langgraph
modules.description: The agent-runtime contract implemented on LangGraph — a compiled StateGraph (ground -> reason -> disclose) executes every reply; the model inside the graph is stub/live-cli/live-api like the base runtime.

modules.name: api-keys
modules.description: Service-to-service callers of generated apps — hashed keys with prefixes, revocation, and last-used tracking.

modules.name: approval-flow
modules.description: Draft -> review -> approve/reject with a full trail — THE core loop of internal tools (our first three real apps all needed it).

modules.name: assignment
modules.description: Route work items to people/queues — fairness rules are policy, not whoever the agent thought of.

modules.name: audit-log
modules.description: Append-only audit trail for app actions — who did what, when. Governance evidence for every generated app.

modules.name: audit-view
modules.description: The uniform 'history' panel over audit-log/row-history — one way to read what happened.

modules.name: auth-basic
modules.description: Minimal session identity — login issues a bearer token, /auth/me resolves it. The Wave-3 sso-oidc module replaces the token issuer without touching callers.

modules.name: backup-restore
modules.description: Scheduled dumps and TESTED restore for the persistence layer — a backup that never restored is a rumor.

modules.name: batch-runner
modules.description: Long operations with progress and resume — the difference between a demo and a tool.

modules.name: blob-store
modules.description: Files and attachments with the same discipline as rows — local dir now, GCS behind the same interface later.

modules.name: cache-layer
modules.description: Read-through TTL caching with explicit invalidation — agents otherwise sprinkle dicts with no invalidation story.

modules.name: calendar-bridge
modules.description: Meetings/deadlines as standard .ics — calendar sync without a calendar API dependency.

modules.name: charting
modules.description: Honest SVG charts (bars/lines) with sane scales — agents freehand charts badly; axes must start at zero for bars.

modules.name: chat-shell
modules.description: Chat UI with streaming-ready message list, wired to POST /chat. Design tokens injected via frontend/tokens.css by scaffold.

modules.name: checklists
modules.description: Structured task lists with completion tracking — onboarding, reviews, audits all need the same primitive.

modules.name: citation-tracker
modules.description: Source attribution structure for grounded answers — trust requires 'says who' on every claim.

modules.name: comments-threads
modules.description: Discussion on any record — the social glue of workflow tools, attached uniformly instead of re-modeled per app.

modules.name: consent-tracking
modules.description: Record the basis for holding each person's data where that matters — consent is evidence, not a checkbox memory.

modules.name: conversation-memory
modules.description: Multi-turn context windows with deterministic summarization — everyone gets truncation wrong per app.

modules.name: corpus-refresh
modules.description: Re-index knowledge when documents change, atomically — RAG apps rot without a refresh story.

modules.name: cost-meter
modules.description: Per-app LLM spend tracking — the deployed sibling of the harness's own cost ledger, so owners see what their app burns.

modules.name: csp-headers
modules.description: Security headers as configuration — the response-header counterpart of the textContent-only frontend policy.

modules.name: dashboard-cards
modules.description: KPI tiles fed by declared queries — count/sum/latest computed one way, formatted one way.

modules.name: data-classification
modules.description: Sensitivity tags per table/column driving retention, redaction, and export rules — policy attached to the data model itself.

modules.name: data-retention
modules.description: TTL/purge honoring the retention answers users give at clarify — the requirement appears in almost every intake.

modules.name: data-table
modules.description: Sortable/filterable/paginated tables — the single most re-built UI artifact in internal tools.

modules.name: doc-extract
modules.description: PDF/docx/HTML/text to clean text+structure — the intake path of most business apps, done once with honest fallbacks.

modules.name: email-ingest
modules.description: 'Forward it to the app' — the lowest-friction intake there is, parsed with the stdlib, no daemon required.

modules.name: email-send
modules.description: Templated transactional mail with suppression rules — compliance-sensitive enough to centralize.

modules.name: env-config
modules.description: Typed, validated runtime configuration — 12-factor with loud startup failures instead of NoneType surprises at 2am.

modules.name: error-reporter
modules.description: Capture and group unhandled exceptions with context — errors owners can triage instead of logs nobody reads.

modules.name: eval-harness
modules.description: Richer eval runner (contains / not_contains / regex rubrics with reports) — evals are how app agents stay honest after changes.

modules.name: export-csv
modules.description: CSV export for any registered table — analysts always need the data out.

modules.name: fallback-chain
modules.description: Model/provider failover policy in one place — retries and degradation are policy, not per-endpoint improvisation.

modules.name: feature-flags
modules.description: Gradual rollout inside generated apps without redeploys — flags as data with deterministic percentage buckets.

modules.name: feed-poller
modules.description: Scheduled pulls from URLs/APIs with dedupe — background ingestion written once, injectable for tests.

modules.name: feedback-inbox
modules.description: In-app feedback capture — end users of the generated app report issues/wishes where they see them; owners triage from one inbox.

modules.name: file-preview
modules.description: Render uploaded documents inline by type — pairs with file-upload/blob-store so previews are uniform.

modules.name: file-upload
modules.description: Safe upload endpoint with type/size allowlists — security-sensitive enough that agents must never improvise it.

modules.name: forms-engine
modules.description: Validated forms from a schema — every CRUD app draws the same form badly; validation must be shared with the backend.

modules.name: guardrails-io
modules.description: Input/output filters (PII, injection heuristics, topic fences) as composable policy instead of scattered regexes.

modules.name: health-plus
modules.description: Deep health checks (store, engine, dependencies) beyond /health's liveness — what readiness probes actually need.

modules.name: import-mapper
modules.description: CSV/XLSX import with column mapping and dry-run — data onboarding for every app, with mistakes caught before commit.

modules.name: input-sanitizer
modules.description: Central request-text hardening beyond schema types — control chars, length caps, and HTML escaping in one place.

modules.name: migrations
modules.description: Ordered, tracked, idempotent schema/data migrations — ad-hoc ALTERs by agents are how data gets destroyed.

modules.name: multi-env
modules.description: dev/staging/prod promotion story — layered env templates merged one way, with prod safety rails.

modules.name: notifications-ui
modules.description: In-app toasts/inbox for events and SLA breaches — one queue, deduped, never stacking forever.

modules.name: ocr-bridge
modules.description: Scanned documents appear in every ops workflow eventually — one interface, explicit availability.

modules.name: pdf-render
modules.description: Generate the PDF artifact (reports, letters, packets) — a valid, dependency-free text PDF writer.

modules.name: permissions-ui
modules.description: The admin screen for rbac — role assignment rendered uniformly instead of re-drawn per app.

modules.name: persistence-core
modules.description: Data layer with table registry. v0 is an in-memory store honoring the same interface the Postgres adapter will implement.

modules.name: pii-redaction
modules.description: Detect and mask PII in stored text and transcripts — the most common compliance ask, done once and tested.

modules.name: postgres-adapter
modules.description: Production Store implementing the persistence-core contract against Postgres — the local-to-production step is a compose choice, not a rewrite.

modules.name: prompt-registry
modules.description: App prompts as versioned data, not string literals buried in code — reviewable and hot-fixable without a rebuild.

modules.name: queue-bridge
modules.description: Task-queue abstraction with ack/retry semantics — in-process now, Pub/Sub behind the same interface at deploy scale.

modules.name: rag-core
modules.description: Chunking + retrieval done right once — grounding quality is the #1 driver of app trust.

modules.name: rate-limit
modules.description: Per-client request throttle — protects agent endpoints (which cost real money per call) from loops and abuse.

modules.name: rbac
modules.description: Approver vs viewer vs admin as declarative roles — permissions must be data, not if-statements scattered by build agents.

modules.name: record-detail
modules.description: Standard detail view with field layout from the data model — one way to show a record.

modules.name: request-metrics
modules.description: Latency/error counters + /metrics — ops can't fly blind, and every app must expose the same shape.

modules.name: rest-client
modules.description: Outbound HTTP with timeout/retry/backoff policy — agents otherwise scatter bare fetches with none.

modules.name: row-history
modules.description: Field-level change history for regulated data — pairs with audit-log to answer 'what changed, from what, to what'.

modules.name: row-level-security
modules.description: 'You see your team's records' — ownership scoping subtle enough that it must be written once, correctly.

modules.name: scheduling
modules.description: Cron-style in-app jobs with visibility and no threads — run_due is called by the host, everything is observable.

modules.name: screen-router
modules.description: Hash navigation binding the design shells' #screen-* mount points — formalizes what every shell implies.

modules.name: search-index
modules.description: Text search over stored rows — every 'find past X' feature reinvents it worse.

modules.name: secrets-manager
modules.description: App secrets via environment with loud failures — never in code, never in the store; enforced by a scanner, not advised.

modules.name: seed-data
modules.description: Deterministic demo/dev fixtures — every stakeholder demo needs believable data, seeded the same way every time.

modules.name: session-audit
modules.description: Login/logout/denied-access trail — identity events feed the same audit stream as business actions.

modules.name: sla-timers
modules.description: Due dates, breach flags, escalations — ops apps are judged on these, and clock math is where bugs hide.

modules.name: slack-notify
modules.description: Where firm users actually live — 'post to the channel' is in every third intake; outbox mode until a webhook is configured.

modules.name: soft-delete
modules.description: 'Deleted' rows auditors can still see — deletion is a policy, so it must be uniform, not per-endpoint improvisation.

modules.name: spreadsheet-io
modules.description: CSV/TSV in and out with type coercion — the lingua franca of analysts, parsed one way.

modules.name: sqlite-adapter
modules.description: Single-file durable Store honoring the persistence-core interface — laptop-class durability without a database server.

modules.name: sso-oidc
modules.description: Firm identity via OIDC ID tokens — replaces auth-basic's issuer while keeping the current_user contract.

modules.name: state-machine
modules.description: Declarative status transitions — scattered ifs are how QA dies; transitions must be data.

modules.name: structured-logging
modules.description: JSON logs with request/user/agent correlation — debugging composed apps needs uniform, parseable logs.

modules.name: table-extract
modules.description: Tables inside documents are where the numbers live — naive text extraction destroys them.

modules.name: token-budgeter
modules.description: Per-conversation/user spend caps inside the generated app — the app-level version of the harness's own cost discipline.

modules.name: tool-registry
modules.description: Declarative tool definitions with roster enforcement — which agent may call what is data, checked at invoke time.

modules.name: transcript-store
modules.description: Standard storage + redaction of agent transcripts — the raw material for evals, audits, and retention policies.

modules.name: usage-analytics
modules.description: Which features actually get used — feeds the owner's roadmap and the firm's ROI story, without third-party trackers.

modules.name: versioned-drafts
modules.description: Draft/publish semantics for content-like records — 'live' and 'working copy' must never be the same row.

modules.name: vuln-watch
modules.description: Dependency advisories for the generated app's requirements — supply-chain awareness without external calls.

modules.name: webhook-in
modules.description: Receive events safely — signature verification and replay protection before anything touches app logic.

modules.name: webhook-out
modules.description: Notify other systems on events with signing and retries — integration's front door, with an outbox you can inspect.

modules.name: workflow-engine
modules.description: Deterministic workflows with agentic nodes inside the generated app — the harness's own architecture (event-sourced, park/resume, contracts) shipped as an app capability.

packs.name: pack-document-review
packs.description: Ingest -> extract -> human review queue -> decision trail for document-centric workflows.

packs.name: pack-intake-triage
packs.description: Form/email intake -> classification -> routing -> SLA — the ops-team workhorse.

packs.name: pack-kb-manager
packs.description: Curate the knowledge corpus itself — staleness, gaps, ownership; the meta-app every RAG deployment needs.

packs.name: pack-report-generator
packs.description: Data in -> analysis -> templated PDF/deck out on a schedule — the recurring-deliverable machine.

packs.name: pack-research-assistant
packs.description: Corpus Q&A with citations and reading-list curation — the knowledge-worker staple.

packs.name: pack-support-copilot
packs.description: Grounded answers + approval gate + history — the shape built three times already (the rule of three, literally).
